title: Just Another Girl on the I.R.T
description:
S1 E1
A hip, intelligent Brooklyn teenager dreams of escaping life in the projects to go to college and eventually become a doctor. Things go awry when she meets a cute dude with a Jeep, a brownstone, and a mom who spends a lot of time at her boyfriend's.

title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
description:
S1 E1
A richly layered ode to the generations of people and places that shape us in a lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a woman's life in Mississippi. The haunting feature debut from award-winning artist Raven Jackson.

title: Coach Carter
description:
S1 E1
An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

title: Jinn
description:
S1 E1
Summer is a 17-year-old carefree black girl whose world is turned upside down when her mother, Jade, abruptly converts to Islam.  Jade becomes a different person, prompting Summer to reevaluate her identity.

title: Black Nativity
description:
S1 E1
Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.

title: On the Come Up
description:
S1 E1
The story 16-year-old Bri, who wants to be one of the greatest rappers of all time. Facing controversies and with an eviction notice staring down her family, Bri doesn't just want to make it, she has to.

title: Body Cam
description:
S1 E1
A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.
